transcript: This artist turns paintings into 3D illusions. This artist creates mind-bending art that literally jumps off the canvas. Wait until you see the last one. It's unreal. In this piece, he breaks part of the frame, making it look like the character is smashing through with a pickaxe. But the next one is even wilder. He uses real rope, threading it through the canvas to make it seem like the girl is clinging to the wall herself. Hit subscribe if this blew your mind like it did mine.
metadata_caption:
You've never seen art like this before! 🎨✨ This artist takes traditional paintings and transforms them into mind-blowing 3D illusions that look like they're breaking out of the canvas!

🔨 One piece shows a character smashing through the frame with a pickaxe… and it looks so real, you'll do a double take.
🧗‍♀️ And in another, he threads actual rope through the canvas, making it look like the subject is climbing the wall in real life!

It's the perfect mix of creativity and illusion-and the results are unreal.

👉 Hit like and subscribe if this artwork blew your mind too!
